title: Diagnostics repeated compact requests
purpose: Exercise compact fixed-format Diagnostics requests over repeated transactions while varying unit, subfunction, and data fields near the minimum complete request shape.
expected_behavior: The server should parse each complete Diagnostics request independently and return a normal response or a protocol-level exception without consuming bytes outside the declared ADU boundaries.
constraints_preserved: Each message has a seven-byte Modbus/TCP MBAP header
Protocol identifier is 0000 in both messages
Each MBAP length 0006 equals the unit identifier plus the five-byte Diagnostics PDU
Each request contains a function code, two-byte subfunction, and two-byte data field
Transaction identifiers and unit identifiers differ across the repeated requests
issue_safety_notes: This is a fresh structural analogue for short and boundary-sensitive request handling. It does not reproduce the reported write-bits input or assert that the cited issue mechanism applies to Diagnostics.
